description: The payload to create a permission scheme

addAddonRole.description: Configuration to generate addon role. Default is false if null. Only applies to GLOBAL-scoped permission scheme

description.description: The description of the permission scheme

name.description: The name of the permission scheme

onConflict.description: The strategy to use when there is a conflict with an existing permission scheme. FAIL - Fail execution, this always needs to be unique; USE - Use the existing entity and ignore new entity parameters; NEW - If the entity exist, try and create a new one with a different name
